hero.label: Flagship Initiative
hero.title: Rural Health Center for Women & Children — Kpotamé, Assahoun
hero.text: Serving 17 villages and over 18,000 people who currently travel up to 40 km for basic medical care. A community that is not waiting — they are building, with you.

roadmap.label: Project Roadmap
roadmap.title: From cleared ground to open doors
roadmap.text: Four phases, built on transparency. Each quarter, donors receive photo and video updates — real progress, real stories.

phases.title: Site Preparation & Foundation
phases.text: The community of Kpotamé contributed their own land and labor. Site clearing is complete. This phase raises $180,000 to lay the foundation — the literal groundwork for everything that follows.

phases.title: Structure & Roofing
phases.text: Walls rise and roofing is completed, creating the physical space for clinical operations. Timeline contingent on reaching the Phase 1 funding milestone.

phases.title: Medical Equipment & Staffing
phases.text: Examination tables, diagnostic tools, maternity ward equipment, and the recruitment of trained healthcare professionals — in partnership with Togo's Ministry of Health.

phases.title: Inauguration & Sustained Operations
phases.text: The center opens its doors. Local NGO partnerships and Ministry integration ensure it will serve the community for generations — self-sustaining, dignified, enduring.

partners.label: Founding Partners
partners.title: Become a Founding Partner
partners.text: Your donation makes you part of this story of transformation. Every level receives quarterly photo and video updates from the field.

levels.title: Prenatal Care Partner
levels.text: Supporting 5 mothers' journeys through safe prenatal care access. You'll receive a welcome story from the field.

levels.title: Examination Room Founder
levels.text: Equipping an essential care space. Your name is recognized as a founding contributor in inaugural materials.

levels.title: Family Health Champion
levels.text: Sponsoring care for 50 families. Includes a virtual meeting with community leaders and a named dedication within the center.
